why_ai: Commoditised screen software where AI agreement platforms absorb the workflow around a solved signature.
why_clarity: An envelope is signed or not, at enormous volume, with completion rate as the metric.
why_digital: Documents in, signed digital agreements out, sold and used entirely online.

why_ai: Consent is medico-legal and obtained in person at the bedside, but capturing it is software.
why_clarity: The right form must be bound to the right patient and encounter before theatre, checkably.
why_digital: Structured procedure data drives digital forms, signed in person and filed in the chart.

why_ai: Every envelope's routing and outcome is recorded, so AI can diagnose stalls and act automatically.
why_clarity: Completion is a single objective number recorded on every envelope.
why_digital: Envelope logs in, automated nudges and routing out, all online.

why_ai: Closings need licensed title agents, notaries and county acceptance, but package assembly automates.
why_clarity: A loan funds and an instrument records, or it does not.
why_digital: Document packages handled digitally, though many closings still meet in a room and record locally.

why_ai: Statute requires a commissioned notary to personally verify and witness, even over remote video.
why_clarity: The notarial act is a simple fixed procedure repeated identically.
why_digital: Physical IDs and documents, witnessed in person or over video, accepted jurisdiction by jurisdiction.

why_ai: Extracting obligations and dates from executed documents is exactly what LLMs now do directly.
why_clarity: Extracted fields are checkable against the document across thousands of agreements.
why_digital: Executed PDFs in, structured obligations and calendars out on screen.

why_ai: Statutes and third-party acceptance, not technology, keep wet ink and human witnesses in these transactions.
why_clarity: Transactions complete or not, but rules differ sharply by transaction type and regulator.
why_digital: Mostly digital documents, with residual paper, in-person signing and jurisdictional acceptance.

why_ai: Per-transaction risk scoring is ML work, though adversarial fraud and deepfakes keep raising demand.
why_clarity: Verification levels are set per transaction at volume, but fraud outcomes surface later.
why_digital: Transaction attributes in, verification decisions out, entirely online.

why_ai: Explaining an agreement and answering signer questions is what LLM assistants do directly.
why_clarity: Comprehension is loosely defined, but completion rate gives a quick measurable signal.
why_digital: Agreements in, explanations and answers delivered inside the online envelope.

why_ai: Near-duplicate detection and clause comparison are ordinary AI tasks; legal approves but does not draft.
why_clarity: Whether a clause matches the approved version is checkable across the library.
why_digital: Template libraries in, cleaned and governed content delivered in software.

why_ai: Versions, populations and signature records are structured data that software audits automatically.
why_clarity: Each employee has signed the current version or not, provable instantly.
why_digital: HR documents and records in, signed evidence delivered online.
